dct_description_sm: This data set contains public events in the City of Montreal as broadcast on [the City calendar] (https://montreal.ca/calendrier). The data provides information on the main characteristics of the event, including date, type of event (e.g. show, public session, exhibition), target audience, cost, and location.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
